main_measure.name: mean sign-flipped drift-removed 3-bar return after forecast < 0 (grid 0,3,6,...)
main_measure.threshold: mean > 0 with day-clustered t >= 2 to confirm; t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of drift-removed 3-bar return on forecast (day-clustered t)

decided_by: Inconclusive rule: neither the confirm nor the reject rule is met (t between -2 and 2 on a measure, or a failed supporting check).
reading: Cases with no close 3 bars later in the same window are left out; the coin's drift is the mean of its non-overlapping 3-bar returns on the 0,3,6,... grid of all its windows; day clustering uses per-day sums of deviations (scores) with a G/(G-1) correction; the slope is fitted on the unflipped drift-removed return with an intercept.
